## Pre-Merge Checklist
- [ ] **Tests & Linting**: `make test` and `make lint` pass cleanly.
- [ ] **Test Coverage**: Test coverage remains $\ge 60\%$ for offline tests.
- [ ] **Secrets & Security**: No credentials, API keys, tokens, `.env`, or real secrets committed.
- [ ] **Documentation**: Relevant ADRs, `README.md`, or architecture documents updated.
- [ ] **Frozen Contract Notice**: Any changes to frozen contracts (ConfigMap, Chroma metadata, schemas) announced to partner and documented in `docs/CONTRACTS.md`.
- [ ] **AI Usage Recorded**: Any AI-assisted code or generation documented in `docs/AI-USAGE.md`.
